Findings (each reproduced twice from scratch)

Tick one off when it is done.","Add a task","Title","Due date","Add task","Task list","Open","Done","All","All caught up","Add a task with the form.","Garden Log · a journal for one garden"]}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-185742-hunt-4704/probes/client-nav-faults.mjs (expectation "waterings-empty-object-shows-error")
2. HIGH   Dashboard shows 'No waterings yet' when the recent-waterings response is invalid
   where: / (GET /api/waterings?limit=5)
   expected: An error saying recent waterings could not be loaded
   saw: {"text":["Waterings","Add sowing, watering or pruning jobs to keep track of them here.","Recent waterings","All waterings","No waterings yet","Use “Water now” on a bed to record one."],"alerts":[]}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-185742-hunt-4704/probes/misc.mjs (expectation "dashboard-bad-response-not-shown-as-empty")
3. MEDIUM While a bed filter loads, rows from other beds stay listed under the new filter
   where: /waterings bed filter
   expected: Only the selected bed's waterings (or no rows) while loading
   saw: {"rows":["12 Nov 2026, 18:58\tNorth bed\t–\tDelete","5 Nov 2026\tShade corner\t4 L\tDelete","1 Nov 2026\tNorth bed\t0 L\tDelete","1 Nov 2026\tNorth bed\t10 L\tDelete","4 Mar 201\tShade corner\t3 L\tDelete","1 Jan 1\tNorth bed\t1 L\tDelete"],"alerts":["Loading waterings…"]}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-185742-hunt-4704/probes/misc.mjs (expectation "loading-filter-hides-other-bed-rows")
4. MEDIUM No way to retry after the waterings list fails to load
   where: /waterings
   expected: A retry control after a load error
   saw: {"btns":0,"text":["Waterings","Every time a bed was watered.","Water a bed","Bed","All beds","North bed","Shade corner","Clear filter","Injected 500","Garden Log · a journal for one garden"]}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-185742-hunt-4704/probes/waterings-faults.mjs (expectation "retry-after-error-on-waterings")
5. MEDIUM Dashboard recent waterings has no retry after an error
   where: / Recent waterings section
   expected: A retry control in the section after a load error
   saw: {"alerts":["Injected 500"],"retry":0}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-185742-hunt-4704/probes/client-nav-faults.mjs (expectation "dashboard-waterings-retry-after-error")
6. MEDIUM Tiny litre amounts accepted and shown as '0 L'
   where: /beds Record past watering (POST /api/waterings)
   expected: Amounts below the field's 0.1 minimum refused, or shown accurately
   saw: ["Recorded 0 L on 1 Nov 2026."]
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-185742-hunt-4704/probes/beds-water.mjs (expectation "tiny-litres-not-shown-as-0L")
7. MEDIUM Far-past watering dates accepted (year 201)
   where: /beds Record past watering (POST /api/waterings)
   expected: An implausible date such as 0201-03-04 is refused with a reason
   saw: {"before":2,"after":3,"alerts":["Recorded 3 L on 4 Mar 201."],"latest":["2026-11-05","0201-03-04","0201-03-04"]}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-185742-hunt-4704/probes/ancient-date.mjs (expectation "far-past-date-refused")
8. LOW    Bed filter select shows 'All beds' while a filter from the URL is applied
   where: /waterings?bed=99999
   expected: The select matches the applied filter, or an unknown bed is reported
   saw: {"select":{"label":"Bed","value":""},"text":["Waterings","Every time a bed was watered.","Water a bed","Bed","All beds","North bed","Shade corner","Clear filter","0 waterings","No waterings for this bed","Pick another bed or record a watering on the beds page.","Clear filter"]}
